create_TaskDict: create a TaskDict with datasets list and img_size tuple for OCR task configuration
build_TasksDict: build a TasksDict containing ocr_with_boxes, ocr_without_boxes, and block_without_boxes task definitions
define_ImageInput: define an ImageInput with type image, a PIL image, and rotated boolean flag
define_TextInput: define a TextInput with type text, a text string, and math boolean flag
create_ProcessorOutput: create a ProcessorOutput with input_ids list and optional image_tiles and grid_thw tensors
